principle: Publicly reachable is not rights-cleared. Search is discovery; use is authorized only by asset-level provenance evidence.

sources.strength: Broad discovery across openly licensed/public-domain media with license filters.
sources.caveat: Openverse itself warns license metadata may be inaccurate; verify the specific work at its source before use.

sources.strength: Large international media commons with per-file author/license metadata.
sources.caveat: Each file can have distinct attribution, personality/privacy/trademark and jurisdictional constraints.

sources.strength: Contemporary high-quality photography and API ecosystem.
sources.caveat: Unsplash License is not public domain; restrictions include selling unmodified images or recreating a competing image service, and depicted subjects/brands can carry other rights.

sources.strength: Photo/video search suitable for product editorial and atmospheric media.
sources.caveat: Use is governed by the current Pexels license/API terms; verify individual asset and third-party rights.

sources.strength: Museum/scientific/cultural assets with CC0 Open Access material and structured data.
sources.caveat: CC0 status does not eliminate every third-party, trademark, privacy, publicity or cultural-sensitivity issue.

sources.strength: Artworks plus IIIF image delivery and public-domain filtering.
sources.caveat: Filter for public-domain/open-access image rights rather than assuming the full collection is reusable.

sources.strength: Curated historical photos/posters/maps and an API/IIIF ecosystem.
sources.caveat: Consult collection/item rights statements; third-party privacy/publicity/copyright can still apply outside curated free-to-use status.

sources.strength: Large CC0 public-domain art image corpus with collection API and high-resolution images.
sources.caveat: Use only objects/images explicitly marked public domain/Open Access; collection metadata can describe restricted works too.
